N1.s: %lldটি ফ্রি কাটলিংই রাখা হয়ে গেছে। কাটলিংয়ে গিয়ে আনলক করলে এটাও রাখা হবে।
N1.back: 5-piece free cutlings-all kept have-become-gone. Cutling-in going unlock if-do this-too kept will-be.
N1.why: The first sentence is S3's word for word so the used-up fact always sounds the same; কাটলিংয়ে গিয়ে (going into Cutling) matches the continue-in-app choice the system offers, and এটাও points at the item Siri was asked to save.

N2.s: %lldটি ফ্রি কাটলিংই রাখা হয়ে গেছে। আরও রাখতে কাটলিং খুলে আনলক করুন।
N2.back: 5-piece free cutlings-all kept have-become-gone. More to-keep Cutling opening unlock do-please.
N2.why: Same opening as N1; here nothing can continue, so it ends on a polite আপনি imperative, and আরও রাখতে echoes S2's আরও কাটলিং রাখুন.

N3.s: রাখা হয়েছে। আর একটি ফ্রি বাকি
N3.back: Kept has-been. More one-piece free remaining
N3.why: বাকি (left over) is what people say of what remains of an allowance; ফ্রি stands alone as in K1, and no closing dari, as in K1's capsule.

N4.why: Uses S29's used/total pair so no positional form is needed; পূর্ণ is the word Bengali phones show for full storage, and N5 repeats it.

N5.s: ফ্রি %lld/%lld পূর্ণ। আনলক করলে এটাও রাখা হবে
N5.back: Free 5/5 full. Unlock if-do this-too kept will-be
N5.why: Same state words as N4; the conditional করলে puts cause and result in one breath, and এটাও tells the person the item in hand is not lost.

N6.why: Bengali iOS navigation-bar buttons are bare words like সম্পন্ন, so the করুন of S15 is dropped for the slot where the save button sits.

N7.s: %lldটি ফ্রি কাটলিংই রাখা হয়ে গেছে। কাটলিং আনলক করলে এটাও রাখা হবে।
N7.back: 5-piece free cutlings-all kept have-become-gone. Cutling unlock if-do this-too kept will-be.
N7.why: S3's opening again, then S28's কাটলিং আনলক করলে with the item word first and the app name second, as the vocabulary uses one word for both.

N8.s: এটা আপনার জন্য তোলা রইল। কাটলিং খুলে আনলক করলেই রাখা হয়ে যাবে।
N8.back: This your for set-aside remained. Cutling opening unlock if-do-just kept become will-go.
N8.why: তোলা রইল is the household idiom for something put aside for someone, kept apart from রাখা, which is the saving verb everywhere else; the -ই on করলেই says that one step is all it takes.
